name: tovu-theme
description: Build Tovu themes, match a reference site, or Tovuize a static website folder. One up-front choice: images into Media and editable Tovu Pages by default, or keep the same look as a static theme without individual page editing. Reuses existing choice, Media, Pages and theme tools, with local/URL font and image import, layout-family shells, asset rewrites and screenshot verification.
author: Tovu

tovu.summary: Build a theme or convert a website into editable Tovu Pages, with a static-theme opt-out.
